title: Amagansett U.S. Life-Saving & Coast Guard Station

services.name: Become a Docent
services.desc: What does a docent do?A docent is a volunteer who guides museum visitors and leads tours for adults and children. I love the Amagansett Station, but there is so much I don’t know about it. We help docents prepare for their valuable role at the museum. Just bring your enthusiasm. My summer schedule is busy. When would I be needed? We coordinate with all our docents to create a schedule that suits everyone during our seasonal open hours. This is a volunteer position and we value any time you can share.
